comment: Overrides for swiftpm-notices.py (run by scripts/bundle-notices.sh from the Gans target's Run Script phase). Keys under packages are SwiftPM identities from Package.resolved. Every entry needs a reason. Paths are relative to this file; checkout:<identity>/<path> points into a package checkout.
preamble: Gans's own code is released under the Unlicense (see LICENSE in the source
repository). The components below are compiled into Gans.app and keep their
own licenses. The Swift runtime and system frameworks ship with macOS.

swift-sodium.reason: On macOS its Clibsodium product links Clibsodium.xcframework, a prebuilt static libsodium; that library's own license is the libsodium component below.

components.name: libsodium
components.reason: Linked statically through swift-sodium's Clibsodium.xcframework; the swift-sodium checkout carries only the wrapper's license. Text from the libsodium tag matching the xcframework's SODIUM_VERSION_STRING.
